facts.fact: Ooredoo Tunisie's own page offers its 188 m2 TIA-942-conformant data centre to business customers as rented racks, cages and shared racks (Housing), with a 99.95% SLA and a 24-month minimum term.

TUN.note: TIA-942 conformity of a facility is a certificate-type claim, not a national standard or rule.
The page does not state who owns Ooredoo Tunisie, so national ownership is not stated.
